beats.summary: Dwight attempts a sales exercise with Wolf and discusses the candidates for a job opening.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: Sell me this piece of paper. Watch this.
Dwight: Nate is a proven entity, but not without his handicaps; hearing, vision, basic cognition.

beats.summary: Dwight struggles to decide whom to hire among his friends and colleagues, feeling hesitant and conflicted.

evidence.snippet: And yet I'm hesitant. Why can't I pull the trigger on any of them?
Trevor: Hey man, we get how difficult this is. And no matter how you choose, we're still gonna be your friend.

beats.summary: Jim informs Dwight that none of the candidates will be hired, causing frustration and disappointment.

evidence.snippet: Jim: And I gotta say, this was a tough decision. And we had to go with none of you.
Dwight: Wow. So much crap. It's just a load of B.C. How could you do this to them?

beats.summary: Dwight and Pam plan to haze the new employee Clark, welcoming him into the office culture.

evidence.snippet: Pam: Hey, Dwight. Wanna haze the new guy?
Dwight: Welcome to the club, pig!

evidence.snippet: I spent all those years looking at Pam, and I fell in love.
